summary: Alice walks from root 0 to any leaf, Bob walks from node bob to the root; gates cost or pay amount[i]; shared gates are split.
mainInsight: Run DFS from Bob's start to find his arrival time at each node on his path to 0. Then DFS from 0 for Alice with time t: take the full amount if t < bobTime[node], half if t == bobTime[node], nothing if Bob arrived earlier. The answer is the maximum income over leaves.

promptVariants: How is each gate's amount resolved based on arrival times?
cards.answer: If Alice arrives strictly earlier than Bob she takes the full amount; if they arrive at the same time they split it (amount / 2); if Bob was there earlier, the gate is already open and it contributes nothing. Alice maximises the sum along root-to-leaf paths.
